collections.description:
Families of tools that share one fetch template, such as decomp.me's
compiler images. Each member becomes the tool `<collection>/<platform>/<name>`.

tools.description: Tools keyed by id, such as `objdiff-cli` or `msvc-4.2`.

Collection.description: A family of tools built from one template.

default-runs.description:
Where members run when `runs` does not name their platform. `detect`
reads the installed executables' formats.

force-include.description: Force-include arguments keyed by platform, as in [`Tool::force_include`].

license.description: License note shared by the members.

platforms.description: Member names keyed by target platform, such as `ps2 = ["ee-gcc2.95.3-136"]`.

runs.description: Where members run, keyed by platform; the rest use `default-runs`.

split.description:
Members published as one image per host OS, keyed by `platform/name`:
the OS names (`linux`, `darwin`) appended to the image path. macOS
hosts take `darwin` when it is listed; every other host takes `linux`.

strip.description: Leading directory inside each image, with the same placeholders.

summary.description: One line on where the members come from.

Get.description: One fetch. Exactly one of `url`, `git`, `oci`, `pypi`, or `npm` is set.

as.description: File name for a single-file `url`; defaults to the URL's last segment.

git.description: A git repository, fetched shallowly at `rev`.

host.description: Host platforms this fetch applies to, such as `macos-aarch64`; empty means all.

npm.description: An npm package installed into a private prefix.

oci.description: An OCI image such as `ghcr.io/owner/name`; every layer is unpacked.

pick.description: Paths to copy from the fetched tree; `from = "to"`. Empty copies everything.

pypi.description: A Python requirement installed into a private virtual environment.

reference.description: Image tag, or the `sha256:` manifest digest to pin.

strip.description: Leading directory to drop from archive and image entries.

url.description: A zip, a plain, gzip, or xz tar, or a single file, recognized by content.

Patch.description: A byte patch whose preimage must match before it is applied.

file.description: File relative to the install root.

to.description: Replacement bytes, hex, the same length as `from`.

bin.description: Command names mapped to paths inside the install.

env.description:
Environment for the tool's commands. `{toolchain}` and `{temp}` expand
to the compiler-visible spellings of those roots.

force-include.description:
Arguments that force-include a header, with `{}` for its path, such as
`["/FI{}"]` for MSVC or `["-include", "{}"]` for GCC.

get.description: Fetches, applied in order into one install directory.

kind.description: `compiler`, `tool`, or `runtime` (something other tools run on, like Wine).

license.description: SPDX expression, or `proprietary` for redistributed vendor compilers.

needs.description: Commands that must be on `PATH`, such as `java` or `node`.

patch.description: Byte patches with a checked preimage, applied after every fetch.

runs.description:
Where the tool's executables run: `host` (native for the downloaded
platform), `windows` (Win32 programs: Wine, wibo, or Docker off
Windows), `linux-x86_64` or `linux-i386` (Docker off Linux), or `detect` (read
from the installed executables' formats).

summary.description: One line on what it is for.

verify.description: SHA-256 of files that must match after install, keyed by relative path.
